purpose: Remove the measured serialized GPU0 NeuralRx front/post stages from the 4.5 ms path by moving the full NeuralRx pipeline to GPU1.
claim_boundary: This two-GPU clean isolated test is neither a production d_MAC qualification nor a WCET bound. It omits MPS, external AI, a real DU clock, and real channels.
mechanism: GPU0 copies raw frequency-domain IQ and starts conventional; GPU1 performs NeuralRx channel estimation through CRC and returns a small result.
decision_rule: Report pair-completion counts at 4.5 ms; do not promote sample statistics to a bound.
